origin.description: A csv tokenizer skips a blank line. Each record is a character vector.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: A csv tokenizer skips a blank line. Each record is a character vector.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
tokens <- tokenize(I("1,2
3,4,5

6"))
paste(vapply(tokens, function(row) paste(row, collapse = "|"), ""), collapse = ";")

translation.details: A csv tokenizer skips a blank line. Each record is a character vector.

tokens = tokenize(I("1,2

6"))
return ";".join("|".join(row) for row in tokens)
